page.title: Automations
page.description: Tasks Toskar's AI does for you on a schedule or when something happens, such as a morning news brief, a price watch, or answering the door. They run in the background, even when this window is closed.
page.emptyDescription: Describe a recurring check, such as a morning price or a Friday release summary, and Toskar will run it on that schedule.
page.confirmDelete: Delete “{{name}}”? Its history is removed too.
page.selectHint: Select an automation to see its history, or create one.
page.createOff: Making automations is turned off for your account. Ask an Admin to turn it on.

intro.title: Put Toskar to work while you're away

when.title: Say when
when.body: Every morning, every Friday, every few hours, or just once.

what.title: Say what to do
what.body: Toskar's AI does it on its own: reads a page, sums up the news, checks a price. It can use the web and the tools you allow.

tell.title: Choose when you hear
tell.body: Every time, only when something changes, or when a condition is met. Every result is kept in its history.

ideas.title: Ideas to start from

news.title: Morning news brief
news.body: A short summary of the day's tech news, every morning.
news.request: Every morning at 7:30 AM, summarize today's top technology news.
news.name: Morning briefing: {{topics}}
news.task: Summarize today's top news about {{topics}} in five short points, with a link to each source.

price.title: Price watch
price.body: Hear when something you want drops below your price.
price.request: Every morning at 8:00 AM, check this product and tell me if the price is below $500.
price.name: Price watch: {{site}}
price.task: Check the current price of the product at {{url}}.

stock.title: Back in stock
stock.body: Hear as soon as a sold-out item can be bought again.
stock.request: Every 6 hours, check whether this item is back in stock and tell me when it becomes available.
stock.name: Back in stock: {{site}}
stock.task: Check whether the item at {{url}} is in stock and can be bought now.

releases.title: Weekly release notes
releases.body: What changed in software you use, every Friday.
releases.request: Every Friday at 9:00 AM, check for new releases of this software and summarize what changed.
releases.name: Release notes: {{software}}
releases.task: Find new releases of {{software}} from the past week and summarize what changed, with the version numbers.

page.title: Page watch
page.body: Hear only when a page you care about changes.
page.request: Every day at 6:00 PM, check this page and notify me only when it changes.
page.name: Page watch: {{site}}
page.task: Read the page at {{url}} and summarize what it says.

folder.title: Folder summary
folder.body: Hear what's new in a folder on this computer, when it changes.
folder.request: Every day at 6:00 PM, summarize what is in this folder and notify me only when it changes.
folder.name: Folder summary: {{folderName}}
folder.task: Summarize the files in the folder {{folder}}: what's new or changed, and anything that needs attention.

door.title: Answer the door
door.body: Greet whoever rings the doorbell, find out why they came, and tell you.
door.request: When someone rings the doorbell, look at the camera, greet the visitor through the doorbell and tell me who is there.
door.name: Answer {{door}}
door.task: Look at the picture from the door. Greet the visitor, find out who they are and why they came, and tell me.

software.label: Software
software.placeholder: a name or a link, such as Node.js

ideas.describeInstead: Describe it in your own words instead

detail.notRunYet: This automation has not run yet.
detail.says: Says its answer at the door
detail.talks: Talks with the visitor and finds out why they came

notice.firstSaved: The first result is saved for comparison.
notice.noPrice: The result did not include a price.
notice.notSignificant: The result was not marked significant.

notify.priceAbove: Notify when the price is above {{amount}}
notify.priceBelow: Notify when the price is below {{amount}}
notify.significant: Notify when the result is significant

parse.noTime8: No time was given, so this runs at 8:00 AM.
parse.noTime9: No time was given, so this runs at 9:00 AM.
parse.describeWhen: Describe when it should run, for example “every morning at 8:00 AM”.
parse.evening: Evening means 6:00 PM unless you set another time.
parse.night: Night means 9:00 PM unless you set another time.
parse.afternoon: Afternoon means 3:00 PM unless you set another time.
parse.morning: Morning means 8:00 AM unless you set another time.
parse.unreadable: That description could not be read.
parse.byModel: The AI read this request. Check the schedule and notification before saving.

form.intro: Tell Toskar what you want it to do.
form.describePlaceholder: Every morning at 8:00 AM, check this product and tell me if the price is below $500.
form.describeHint: Say when it runs and what to do. Toskar fills in the details below, and you can change any of them.
form.name: Name
form.taskHint: What Toskar does each time it runs.
form.noticesGo: Notices go to the bell in Toskar and, if Settings allow, to this computer's notifications.
form.installModel: Install a model before creating an automation.
form.conditionHint: Toskar checks the result against this condition. The task itself stays in ordinary language.
form.tools: Tools it may use while you're away
form.toolsHint: Approve what this automation needs now; nobody will be around to answer later. If it reaches a tool you didn't approve, it skips it and you get a notification. Leave everything unchecked to use only the read-only tools the profile allows.
form.changeTools: These change things on this computer
form.changeToolsHint: Approve one only if this automation needs it. It will run without asking.
form.wouldNotNotify: A notice would not be sent
form.testHint: Runs it once now without saving, so you can see what you'd get.
form.monthDayHint: In a shorter month, it runs on the last day.
form.cronHint: Five fields, in the time zone below: minute, hour, day of the month, month, and day of the week.
form.saveResults: Also save each result as a file
form.saveFolderHint: A new Markdown file for each result, in your home folder.
form.runsFeed: When a feed has new posts
form.runsFolder: When a file or folder changes
form.runsWebhook: When another service calls its link (webhook)
form.watchHint: Toskar checks it on the schedule below and runs only when something changed, telling the task what it was.
form.webhookHint: It runs when another service calls its link. Make the link on the automation's page after saving.
form.manualHint: It runs only when you press Run now, or from its webhook.
form.afterHint: It runs right after the other automation, given its result. A run that follows another can't use tools that change things outside Toskar.
form.deviceHint: It runs the moment the device changes, told what changed. Changes during the wait after a run start no other run, so a sensor that flickers runs it once.
form.camerasHint: Each run starts with a picture from these cameras, shown to a model that can see. Up to {{count}}.
form.say: Say the answer at the door
form.sayHint: Toskar reads each run's answer aloud through the doorbell's speaker, and says nothing when nobody is there to talk to.
form.sayQuiet: Quiet hours, when it only notifies
form.needsToolModel: The model chosen can't use tools, so it won't open pages or run the tools picked here: it answers from what it already knows. Choose a model that can use tools, or install one.
form.actions: Actions it may take on its own
form.actionsHint: Each run may make these calls without asking, even when a trigger started it. Any other call that changes something is skipped. Choose only what you'd let it do with nobody watching.
form.sayListenHint: After the first words, Toskar listens through the doorbell's microphone, answers, and finds out who came and why. It never says whether anyone is home. You're notified with a summary of the visit. Needs ffmpeg on this computer.

draft.label: Automation to confirm
draft.hint: Nothing runs until you create it.

digest.title: Automation digest
digest.intro_one: What your automation found since the last digest.
digest.intro_other: What your {{count}} automations found since the last digest.

trigger.webhook: When its webhook link is called

webhook.title: Webhook link
webhook.shownOnce: Copy it now: it's shown only once. Anyone with the link can start this automation.
webhook.howTo: Send a POST request to it. The body, up to 64 KB, is given to the task as data.
webhook.noLink: Make a link for another service to call.
webhook.hasLink: This automation has a link. It's shown only when it's made.
webhook.replaces: A new link stops the old one.

door.nobodyAnswered: Someone came to the door. Toskar greeted them, and nobody answered.
door.nobodyThere: Nobody was in the picture, so nothing was said at the door.
